program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((objs (sort (objects g 0)
                     (lambda (a b)
                       (if (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                           (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))
                           (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))))))
         (areas (map obj-size objs))
         (n (length objs)))
    (grid-from-fn n n
      (lambda (i j)
        (let ((ai (list-ref areas i)) (aj (list-ref areas j)))
          (if (= ai aj) 1 (if (> ai aj) 2 3)))))))
